_doc.zh: 软组织求解器在当前几何上的验证结果（tools/softbody/validate.ts 生成）；literature 是 validation.json 里对应的已发表数值；phase1 是第一阶段报告过的数（当时的求解器和笼子），留作前后对照。几何还会改，改后要重跑。
_doc.en: Validation results of the soft-tissue solver on the current geometry (written by tools/softbody/validate.ts); `literature` holds the matching published numbers of validation.json; `phase1` holds the numbers reported in phase 1 (the solver and cages of that time), kept for comparison. The geometry will change, after which this must be rerun.

site.en: forearm, the high-fat-thickness site (P2 of the paper)

caveat.zh: 单个受试者；该点在前臂上的确切位置没有在打开的文字里给出，本项目取前臂掌侧中段。
caveat.en: One subject; the exact position of the site on the forearm is not given in the text opened, so the mid volar forearm is used here.

paperModel.where: Table 8 (P2, 27 skin–fat–muscle combinations in the paper's own subject-specific model); section 2.3 (site selection)

selection.zh: P2 选在手–前臂体表脂肪最厚的区域；受试者坐着，前臂放在水平支撑台上；模型里支撑面、模型底面和肱骨近端完全固定。
selection.en: P2 is the region of greatest fat thickness on the hand–forearm surface; the subject sat with the forearm on a horizontal support; in the model the support plane, the model base and the proximal humerus are fully fixed.

note.zh: 表中是绝对误差，正负号没有给出。即使在该文自己的解剖几何上，本项目第二阶段的材料组合在 P2 也差 35%。
note.en: The table gives absolute errors without sign. Even on the paper's own anatomy, the material set of phase 2 of this project misses P2 by 35 %.

site.zh: 前臂，肌肉最厚处（该文的 P3）
site.en: forearm, the high-muscle-thickness site (P3 of the paper)

indentation.where: section 2.5 (prescribed 3.5 mm minus 0.3 mm gap) and the note of Table 9

paperModel.where: Table 10 (P3, post hoc screening of all 27 combinations) and Table 9

selection.zh: P3 选在肌肉最厚的区域。
selection.en: P3 is the region of greatest muscle thickness.

note.zh: 在该文的几何上，本项目的材料组合在 P3 差 5.7%；本模型在自己的前臂上差 36%，所以 P3 的差距来自几何（受试者与本模型的层厚、到骨的距离、曲率），不是材料。
note.en: On the paper's geometry the material set of this project misses P3 by 5.7 %; this model misses it by 36 % on its own forearm, so the gap at P3 comes from geometry (layer thicknesses, depth to bone and curvature of the subject against this model), not from the material.

site.en: hand, the skin-dominant site (P1 of the paper)

caveat.zh: 十名 25–37 岁男性的平均曲线。表 4 的 RMSE 列单位写的是 N/mm；个体曲线和取值范围只在该文的图 4 和补充材料里，没有读取，所以这里没有受试者间的离散范围。
caveat.en: The mean curve of ten males aged 25–37. The RMSE column of Table 4 is labelled N/mm; individual curves and value ranges are only in Figure 4 and the supplement of the paper and were not read, so no between-subject spread is given here.

site.en: abdomen, centre of the rectus abdominis below the umbilicus (R3 of the paper), supine and relaxed

forcePolynomialN.note: f(δ) = f1·δ² + f2·δ, δ in mm

what.zh: 乳房内标志点从俯卧到仰卧的位移（刚性对齐之后）
what.en: displacement of landmarks inside the breast from prone to supine (after rigid alignment)

posture.where: abstract; Table 3 (initial TRE by group) and Table 4 (shear modulus per case)

use.zh: 俯卧到仰卧，重力反转（变化 2g）。本项目直接模拟俯卧和仰卧两个状态再相减，不再用线性换算。站立到仰卧（重力转 90°，变化 √2·g）该文没有数据；按线性比例约为 0.71 倍只是本项目的推算，大变形下不成立。受试者是乳腺癌患者，乳房体积在打开的段落里没有给出；该文的乳房可沿胸壁滑动，本模型里乳房底面粘在胸壁上。
use.en: Prone to supine reverses gravity (a change of 2g). This project now simulates the prone and the supine state and takes the difference instead of scaling linearly. The paper has no standing-to-supine data (gravity turned by 90°, a change of √2·g); the factor 0.71 by linear scaling is this project's inference only and does not hold at large deformation. The subjects are breast cancer patients whose breast volume is not given in the passages opened; the breast of that paper may slide along the chest wall, whereas here its base is bonded to it.

phase3.zh: 第三阶段没有在女性身体上重跑（女性身体正在重建，按要求不读）。原因的分析用不读人体数据的体模（tools/softbody/phantom.ts），结果在 validation-report.json 的 ours.breastPhantom。
phase3.en: Not rerun on the female body in phase 3 (the female body is being rebuilt and was not to be read). The causes were analysed on a phantom that reads no body data (tools/softbody/phantom.ts); results under ours.breastPhantom of validation-report.json.

analytic.formula: F = 2·a·E·δ·κ(ν, a/h) / (1 − ν²); κ → 1 for a/h → 0 (elastic half-space)

caveat.zh: 该文表 1 的 k 值是它自己的水射流压头的有限元结果（a/h = 0.17 时 k < 1），不是刚性压头的 Hayes κ，所以没有采用；Hayes 原文的 κ 表没有打开。本项目的解析算例只用 κ > 1 这一性质和网格收敛。
caveat.en: The k values of Table 1 of that paper are finite-element results for its own water-jet indenter (k < 1 at a/h = 0.17), not Hayes' κ for a rigid punch, so they are not used; the κ table of Hayes' paper was not opened. The analytic cases of this project use only κ > 1 and mesh convergence.

what.zh: 跑步时小腿软组织标志点相对骨段的位移（峰–峰）
what.en: displacement of soft-tissue markers on the calf relative to the segment in running (peak to peak)

softTissueMotion.where: discussion: compression reduced calf displacement by 1.3 mm (~13 %), up to 1.9 mm (~20 %) and 1.8 mm (~11 %)

caveat.zh: 表 2 的数值在打开的 XML 里读不出来；这里的无压缩对照值是由正文里“减少的毫米数 ÷ 减少的百分比”反推的，只作量级用：跑步时软组织相对骨的摆动是一到两厘米。
caveat.en: The numbers of its Table 2 could not be read from the XML opened; the control values here are back-computed from the text's “millimetres reduced ÷ per cent reduced” and serve for the order of magnitude only: soft tissue swings by one to two centimetres relative to bone in running.

cantilever.what: tip deflection of a cantilever under its own weight over Euler–Bernoulli theory (which has no ν in it)

punchDynamicSolver.what: flat punch a = 12 mm on a bonded block 72 × 48 × 72 mm, ν = 0.49, real density: F ÷ 2·E·a·δ/(1 − ν²)

pressOnBlock.what: the same case through press(); the half-space centre pressure is half the mean

jacobi.what: the Jacobi mode with mass splitting against Gauss–Seidel: (a) static cantilever, cell = half the depth, ν = 0.49; (b) flat punch, cell 8 mm (700 nodes)

jiggle.motion: hip_L flexion 40° in 0.15 s, then held; corrective displacement in mm: of skin vertices (largest), of cage nodes (largest and 99th percentile)
